installCommand: if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 "$HOME/flutter"; fi && export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin" && flutter doctor
buildCommand: echo "{\"mapboxAccessToken\": \"$MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN\"}" > assets/env.json && export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/flutter/bin" && flutter build web
